title: Hemnet.se Scraper
description: Scrape property listings from Hemnet.se for-sale pages. You can use a direct Hemnet search URL or optional filters.

startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: Hemnet for-sale URL, for example https://www.hemnet.se/till-salu

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Optional keyword filter applied on top of the start URL.

location.title: Location
location.description: Optional location slug fallback when URL has no filters.

max_pages.title: Maximum number of pages
max_pages.description: Safety cap for paginated API requests.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy setup used for requests. Apify Proxy is enabled by default because Hemnet blocks direct datacenter requests.
